verdict.rationale: Jev documents sending many questions in a single API call (fan-out and parallel-question batching, claimed 12.2x cheaper and 10x faster), and a guardrails cookbook screens every message with one request, so multi-item evaluation per call is a first-party capability. Bulk is bounded by a 64k-token per-request budget, and there is no documented batch or job API for processing many separate states or items at once. Missing for 10: a dedicated bulk/batch endpoint across many states, documented item-count limits, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
